COLDWAR_IRQ_seed_starting_spirits = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = IRQ
			original_tag = IRQ
			is_dynamic_country = no
			OR = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
				AND = { date > 1969.12.31 date < 1985.1.1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_july_state }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_july_state }

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_rural }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_rural }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_patronage }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_patronage }

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_frontier }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_frontier }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_starting_spirits_seeded }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_starting_spirits_seeded
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = literacy_rate }
				}
				set_variable = { literacy_rate = 0.35 }
			}
			add_ideas = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_july_state
				COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_unsettled_north
				COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_ipc
				COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_rural
				COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_literacy
				COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_patronage
				COLDWAR_IRQ_spirit_frontier
			}
		}
	}
}
